title: Fuga ad quatuor (Martini)
desc: Johannes Martini, Fuga ad quatuor. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Mar3008); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
